```sql
SELECT ROUND(
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p."AcceptedAnswerId" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE)
    / COUNT(*),
    4
) AS acceptance_rate
FROM main."posts" p
WHERE p."PostTypeId" = 1
  AND p."CreaionDate" >= '2010-12-01'
  AND p."CreaionDate" < '2011-01-01'
  AND p."CreaionDate" < '2011-02-01';
```
